title: Machu Picchu: drawn by hand
kaylee: Tika's mountain is hand-drawn now: a new fluffy Tika, llama friends that blink and hop, pastel Inca walls and a new opening picture.
questions: I took "landing page" to mean this level's opening screen. Is that the one you meant?
The Peru map and its other three games still use generated pictures. Redraw those next?

pictures.title: Tika
pictures.caption: Redrawn: bigger head, fluffy coat, no black outline. Her friends are the same llama in brown, grey and baby peach.
